about: Where each aircraft's afterburner starts on the game's throttle axis (0 = idle end, 1 = full), its idle cut-off region on the axis (idleGate), source and confidence. Read from the games' own files and manuals (static analysis, 2026-10-17); see docs/axis-curves.md "Detent mode".

aircraft.title: F-15E Strike Eagle (RAZBAM)
aircraft.source: <DCS>\Mods\aircraft\F-15E\Options\options.dlg:203-204 ('Position of throttle cutoff detent in axis percent (15% IRL)', 'Position of throttle afterburner detent in axis percent (64% IRL)'); optionsDb.lua:27-28; Cockpit\ControlsIndicator\ControlsIndicator_page.lua:146-147 (idle 19/130, MIL 83/130 PLA)
aircraft.notes: Explicit axis-percent options. Real-jet values per dialog: cutoff 15%, AB 64% (= PLA 83/130). Gates follow the user's option value; defaults shown.

aircraft.title: F-14A/B Tomcat (Heatblur)
aircraft.source: <DCS>\Mods\aircraft\F14\Options\optionsData.lua:49-63; F14\Docs\F-14 Manual.pdf p1174-1175 ('if set to 80%, the MIL power range ... between 0% and 80% of your physical throttle ... 20% for the deadzone and 80% for the detent results in afterburner activation at 82% and deactivation at 78%')
aircraft.notes: Axis 0 = IDLE (OFF via keybinds). In-game lever MIL mark is fixed at 0.8 of lever travel in the Controls Indicator (ControlsIndicator_page.lua:193), so HB remaps axis [0,detent]->lever [0,0.8]. aircraft.title: F-16C Viper (ED)
aircraft.source: <DCS>\Mods\aircraft\F-16C\Cockpit\Scripts\ControlsIndicator\ControlsIndicator_page.lua:23-24 (throttleIdle = 0.1, throttleMil = 0.775), :157-158 (idle/ab marks); Doc\DCS F-16C Early Access Guide EN.pdf p22, p25 (indicator legend 'Afterburner Detent Marker', 'Idle Detent Marker')
aircraft.gameOption: abDetent (default 0, enum: 0 Always off (AB by axis only), 1 Always on (needs 'Cycle Afterburner Detent' key to pass MIL); <DCS>\Mods\aircraft\F-16C\Options\optionsDb.lua)
aircraft.notes: Values are positions on the module's own throttle-lever scale (0 = lever fully aft incl. OFF/STOP region, 1 = max AB) taken from the Controls Indicator (RCtrl+Enter) script. Assumption: ED maps the Thrust axis 1:1 to that lever (the region below the idle mark can only be entered while the cutoff/latch button is held, otherwise the lever stays at idle). This is inferred from the held 'cutoff release'/'finger lift'/'idle latch' binds, not stated in a file. If ED instead remaps axis 0..1 onto idle..max, the AB start would be (mil-idle)/(1-idle) - see altStartIfIdleRemapped. ED's option does not move the detent position; it only adds a soft gate at MIL. If DCS stretches the axis over idle..max instead of 1:1, the afterburner starts at 0.75.

aircraft.title: JF-17 Thunder (Deka)
aircraft.source: <DCS>\Mods\aircraft\JF-17\Cockpit\Scripts\ControlsIndicator\Indicator\ctrl_indicator_page.lua:156-161 (comment '加力参考线' = afterburner reference line at y = 0.66667*hh on a scale -hh..+hh), :210-211 (EFM_THROTTLE_POSITION moves 0..1 over 2*hh)
aircraft.notes: AB reference line = (0.66667+1)/2 = 0.8333 of EFM_THROTTLE_POSITION. Assumes EFM throttle position is linear to the Thrust axis (HOTAS_Throttle_Abs, command 2004). Deka also has an 'Afterburner Toggle' command and AB switch (PNT_524). No special option. English quick guide has no number; CN manual text not extractable.

aircraft.source: <Falcon BMS 4.38>\Docs\00 BMS Manuals\BMS-User-Manual.pdf p35-36 ('Left-click on SET AB = Set Afterburner detent (green). Right-click = Set Idle detent (red). By default no detents are set... markers at the top (green) and bottom (red)'); BMS-Technical-Manual.pdf p16, p25
